research_question: Under a fixed temporal novel-purchase full-catalog protocol on the controlled Vietnamese retail benchmark v5, does the proposed decoupled Wide-and-Deep Two-Tower Hybrid improve ranking effectiveness over the strongest faithfully reproduced baseline selected using validation data?
sub_questions: Within the preregistered cold-item cohort, does Hybrid preserve or improve ranking quality relative to independent Deep and the strongest collaborative-only comparator?
On the train-defined rule-aligned cohort, does removing the Apriori-derived Wide branch reduce ranking quality relative to the full Hybrid?
Does the direction of the locked Hybrid effect replicate on at least one public external commerce dataset that preserves the essential model and task contract?
After all accuracy gates pass, does the verified bundle satisfy preregistered latency, throughput, and memory gates on a fixed runner?

in_scope: Faithful baseline reproduction and harmonized shared-protocol evaluation
Public external validation when the essential task and model contract is preserved
Post-accuracy runtime evaluation on a fixed runner
out_of_scope: Online A/B testing or causal business impact
New-user or zero-history cold-start without a separate protocol
Raw metric comparison across different datasets or candidate universes
Claims about natural Vietnamese shopper behavior from generated v5 behavior
scope.domain: Offline top-k recommender-system benchmarking for retail and e-commerce
scope.timeframe: Frozen dataset-specific temporal windows; v5 spans 2026-01-01 through 2026-08-01 UTC; literature evidence through 2026 will be verified in Stage 1B
scope.geography: Vietnamese retail context for v5 and the Vietnamese sensitivity track; multilingual commerce only for external-validity testing
scope.population: Eligible dataset-defined user histories and full-catalog item candidates; v5 units are generated user histories rather than recruited human participants

theoretical_framework: Operational memorization-generalization complementarity: an Apriori-derived Wide branch represents explicit train-observed co-purchase regularities, while a Deep Two-Tower/content branch represents generalization from histories and item features; fusion is a demonstrated mechanism only if the preregistered ablation supports it.
hypothesis: H1: Hybrid must have a paired 95% confidence-interval lower bound greater than zero for NDCG@10, HR@10, and macro per-user GAUC versus each metric-specific validation-selected locked baseline. H2: On the cold-item cohort, the lower bound for NDCG@10(Hybrid minus independent Deep) must be at least zero and semantic traps must pass 10/10. H3: On the train-defined rule-aligned cohort, the lower bound for NDCG@10(full Hybrid minus no-Wide ablation) must be greater than zero. H4: At least one full-contract public external dataset must retain a positive Hybrid NDCG@10 effect under the harmonized protocol; if no compatible dataset exists, H4 is NOT_TESTED.
exclusion_criteria: Users without at least one novel organic purchase in the target split
Seen items as recommendation candidates after masking
External datasets without verified license, immutable revision, task mapping, and sufficient signal compatibility
Baseline adapters without provenance, parity, and official-protocol reproduction acceptance
Any result generated after unauthorized test access or a protocol-changing code revision
ethical_flags: Controlled or generated behavior must not be represented as natural human behavior
Dataset and catalog provenance, license, PII, and redistribution rights require verification
External public datasets may still require institutional exempt-status confirmation
No deployment or user-impact claim is supported by offline metrics alone
